Guidance & outlook: India sold approximately 2.17 crore two-wheelers in FY26 alone.
Government data indicates that approximately 22.69 crore tyres were manufactured in the country during Fy25.
Against a market of this size, our ambition to build Viaz towards approximately ₹400 crore of annual revenue by FY29 does not require us to become one of India's largest tyre companies.
Growth & demand: We closed the year with revenue from operations of ₹108.34 crore, compared with ₹57.26 crore in the previous year, registering growth of approximately 89%.

A January 2026 NITI Aayog study, using industry data, indicates that two- and three-wheeler tyres account for approximately 53% of tyre production by volume, passenger-car tyres for approximately 26%, truck and bus tyres for 11%, LCV tyres for 5%, agricultural and farm tyres for 4% , with other categories constituting the balance.
